text:
maria: Quick question about the rollouts contingency UX — during the 0.9->1.0 roll we auto-routed a subset to the cheaper-quant model after transient 503 spikes. Ops asked for an 'undo' affordance + an audit link. Should the console show a dismissible banner, a tiny pill in the route header, or nothing at all?

aj: tiny pill in header + toast the first time. banners are too noisy for PLG customers. pill contains: model name, reason ('503 spike'), time, and a link to 'undo' that sends operator revert. :thumbsup:

sam: +1 for pill. also strongly want a per-rollout dry-run toggle that generates the same audit records and sampling but doesn't actually change routing. helps rehearse.

zoe: telemetry needs: capture trigger signal (e.g., 5xx-rate, p50/p95 latency), sample inputs (hashed) for QA, and snapshot model output diffs when we switch. sampling rate should be per-rollout.

maria: agreed. ops also asked we surface what exact trigger fired. e.g., was it 'client 502s', 'infra 503s', or sustained latency? UI should show the primary trigger + metric sparkline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 1739009876 started by @maria at 1739009876 -> contingency triggered at 1739009950 (5xx_rate > 2%) — routed 122/1.2k requests to cheaper-quant. logs -> https://internal.logs/r/1739009876

nate: question: config schema — do we let customers pick 'error codes' vs 'latency' vs 'availability zone' as triggers? or have preset buckets?

maria: propose config like (console + API parity):
```json
{
  "contingency_mode": "soft-switchover",
  "triggers": [
    {"type": "error_rate", "scope": "client", "threshold": 0.02, "window_s": 60},
    {"type": "p95_latency_ms", "threshold": 1200, "window_s": 60}
  ],
  "sampling_rate": 0.01,
  "dry_run": false,
  "fallback_model": "cheaper-quant-v2",
  "ttl_s": 300
}
```

aj: UI details: show the active policy pill + a small chevron to open policy quickview (editable modal). Quickview includes an 'Undo last switchover' button (grace guarded), and 'Simulate' that runs dry-run immediately.

sam: telemetry/QA: when dry_run=true we should still emit an audit event with same metadata but mark it simulated. that way playback tools can reproduce. Also we should allow sampling of inputs to be globally turned off for regulated customers.

zoe: privacy note: sampled inputs must be hashed + truncated. we should add a toggle for 'capture inputs' with a warning in the modal.

nate: about triggers: we need to separate "client errors" (4xx from callers) vs infra 5xx — otherwise customers will be surprised. console should call them out separately in the reason text.

maria: good call. also add an estimated cost delta in the pill ("+0.8 tokens/req if fallback") so product teams see immediate impact.

aj: final UX ask: breadcrumbs in rollout detail: timeline of triggers, actions, who clicked undo. exportable CSV for audits.

maria: I'll mock this in FigJam and open a PR for console + API schema. owners: @aj for UI, @zoe for telemetry, @sam for API.

sam: I'll add the API patch and wire the dry_run field. quick curl to fetch audit lines for a rollout: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.api.internal/rollouts/1739009876/audit?limit=100"`

zoe: I'll add sampling + PII guards.

maria: Thanks all — will post mock and tracking issue. :rocket: 

aj: thanks, looks actionable.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note -> audit events will be emitted under job:contingency-svc by default.

maria: cool — updating the tracking issue now.
